ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between low-intensity (dark) base pigmentation and high-intensity (white/light gray) mottled spots and ring-like clusters across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity central area with high-intensity mottled blobs and ring-shaped pixel clusters distributed across both lobes, increasing in density toward the trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes along the entire trailing edge; peak density is highest on the outer lateral sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct convex sweep extending from the median notch to the acute terminal tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial distribution of circular, high-contrast white-pixel rings (rosette patterns) across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of fine, unaligned linear pixel disruptions, including a prominent vertical light-colored streak on the mid-right lobe and several shorter marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosette constellations) and localized linear rake-like marks across the fluke surface.
